task_instructions: The PLR1711 useless-return linter rule removes redundant return statements. However, when the return statement has a trailing inline comment (for example: return # subSchema.__init__()), the current safe fix deletes the comment alongside the statement. Preserve trailing comments or mark fixes that remove comments as unsafe.
expected_behavior: When an unnecessary return statement contains a trailing comment, the linter must either retain the comment or mark the fix as unsafe so comments are not silently stripped during automatic formatting.
